description: User-controlled attribute.ID interpolated into bash -c via fmt.Sprintf when filtering GZIP records; regexp.QuoteMeta escapes regex but not shell metacharacters, enabling OS command injection.
getPayloadFromRequest calls io.ReadAll(r.Body) with no http.MaxBytesReader wrapper; the maxReqSize check at handle.go:494 occurs only after full buffering, allowing memory DoS.
DrainConfigHttpHandler mounts PUT /job/{job_run_id} without authentication or authorization; any caller with network reach can insert rows into the drain_config table.
UncompressMiddleware wraps gzipped request bodies via gzip.NewReader with no decompressed-size cap, enabling gzip-bomb amplification that exhausts gateway memory before MaxReqSize check.
blockPrivateIPs defaults to false per destination type, so the SSRF guard in DialContext is disabled unless explicitly enabled, letting tenant destinations target internal IPs.
testClientOptions hardcodes tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify:true}; reachable in production when tenants supply a TestConfig.Endpoint in their Google Sheets destination configuration.
LookupRudderIDs builds SQL via fmt.Sprintf with merge_property_type='%s' where prop.Type is interpolated unquoted; a single-quote in Type escapes the literal allowing SQL injection.
ReadTimeout and ReadHeaderTimeout default to 0 (unlimited) for the processor HTTP server config, leaving the listener open to Slowloris-style connection exhaustion attacks.
JOBS_DB_PASSWORD=password ships as the default credential in the canonical docker-compose env file; operators who omit overrides expose the JobsDB role with a trivial secret.
JOBS_DB_SSL_MODE=disable forces unencrypted PostgreSQL traffic between rudder-server and JobsDB in the default container stack, exposing credentials and event payloads on the wire.
JOBS_DB_SSL_MODE=disable in the published sample env propagates into typical deployments, encouraging operators to run the PostgreSQL connection without TLS encryption.
MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=password is a weak default credential for the storage compose profile; MinIO admin and S3-compatible bucket are protected only by a trivially guessable secret.
ALLOW_NONE_AUTHENTICATION=yes disables etcd authentication entirely in the multi-tenant compose profile; any client reaching etcd can read or mutate cluster coordination state.
ReplaceConfigWithEnvVariables logs the entire workspaceConfig payload at error level via NewStringField on parse failure; payload routinely contains destination secrets and OAuth tokens.
drainJob returns the raw database error string to the HTTP client via http.Error(w, err.Error(), 500), leaking PostgreSQL driver and schema details on failure.
UNIX socket at /tmp/rudder-server.sock created via net.Listen with no explicit umask or chmod; default permissions may yield world-readable or world-writable access on shared hosts.
mkdir -p $RUDDER_TMPDIR uses unquoted variable expansion; if an attacker influences this env var, shell word-splitting can yield unintended mkdir argument injection.
error_log set to debug level retains verbose request data including upstream error bodies, increasing the risk of sensitive payload fragments reaching disk logs in production.
Reverse-proxy server block sets no Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, or Content-Security-Policy response headers; clients receive no hardening hints.
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=password is a weak default credential in the demo compose template; this file functions as the public starting point for many self-hosted deployments.
